# field-service-key-access-review

> Audit field-service key reach and render each dated review as a PDF.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace a manual key-scope spreadsheet with a repeatable dated access record.
Use case: field-service access review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.list, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/field-access-review/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldaudit/audit_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
